这里还很安静: A quiet space for your favorites
支持 WAV、FLAC、MP3、OGG 等格式，保存在本机。: Import WAV, FLAC, MP3, OGG and more. Files stay on this device.

让声音陪你慢慢入睡: Let the sounds ease you into rest
会记住每种声音和各自的音量。: Saves every sound and its volume.
自动平衡基础响度 · 峰值保护 · 最高 300%: Balanced baseline levels, peak protection, up to 300% gain
首尾静音清理 · 最长 4 秒交叉淡化: Trims silent edges and crossfades up to 4 seconds
保留原文件，循环处理只在内存中进行。无损格式不代表原始录音一定无损；不会通过升采: Original files stay unchanged. Loop processing happens in memory. A lossless container does not guarantee a lossless source; we do not upsample to claim better quality.
已移除导入副本，原文件未改动: Imported copy removed. Your original file is unchanged.
一间随时可以回来的安静房间。所有声音在本机播放，不需要账户，也不会上传你的录音。: A quiet space you can return to. Everything plays locally, with no account and no audio uploads.
先清理首尾静音，再将首尾最多 4 秒交叉混合成连续波形，交给音频引擎直接循环。播: Silent edges are trimmed, then up to four seconds of the ends are crossfaded into a continuous buffer. The audio engine loops it directly. Playback and volume changes fade smoothly. Each recording gets baseline loudness balancing: 100% is the balanced level, with gain available up to 300%.
录音中的雷声、鸟鸣等事件仍会重复。系统主动休眠、合盖休眠或音频设备断开会影响播放: Recorded events such as thunder and birds will still repeat. System sleep, closing the lid or disconnecting an audio device can interrupt playback. Minimizing the window keeps it playing.
内置 {count} 段录音和 3 种合成噪声。: Includes {count} recordings and three generated noise colors.
录音采用 CC0、Public Domain 或 CC BY 授权。每段录音的作: Recordings use CC0, Public Domain or CC BY licenses. Find each author and license in the sound details and bundled credits.
个人音源库包含尚未逐段核实授权的 Moodist 音源，请勿将此版本作为公开音源: The personal library includes Moodist recordings whose redistribution licenses have not been individually verified. Do not redistribute this personal edition.
音源清单、真实规格、下载校验和授权文件随应用附带。请按各录音的许可保留署名。: The sound catalog, actual file specifications, checksums and license records are bundled with the app. Keep attribution where each recording requires it.
关闭频谱动画和背景模糊，降低图形负担。声音不受影响。: Disables visualizer animation and background blur to reduce graphics work. Audio is unchanged.
空格播放 / 暂停；Tab 切换控件；方向键调节音量。最多同时混合 8 种声音。: Space plays or pauses. Tab moves between controls. Arrow keys adjust sliders. Mix up to eight sounds. Closing the window exits the app.
100% 为平衡后标准音量，最高可增强至 300%: 100% is the balanced baseline. Boost up to 300%.
